purpose: Explicit manual user-requested new Hydrocotyle bonariensis field-ID and public-photo lesson, not a scheduled bot or county native approval.
user_requested: Build Hydrocotyle bonariensis as the third genus lookalike after H. umbellata and H. verticillata, with real licensed morphology photographs, accurate arrows, taxonomic nuance, and GitHub Pages publication.

photos.individual_photo_license: All six iNaturalist source photo license_code=cc-by; exact subversion unconfirmed, photographer and source page preserved. Original JPEGs preserved at source; derivatives strip EXIF and resized; 3 derivatives carry annotated arrows.
photos.anatomical_review: 3 full-size committed arrowed photos read back; green umbel branchpoint, primary rays, and underside petiole insertion point verified. Early off-target ray arrows corrected on exact SHA-matched originals.

taxon.accepted_name: Hydrocotyle bonariensis Comm. ex Lam. (Kew POWO)
taxon.prior_synonym_issue: Kew places Hydrocotyle verticillata var. triradiata under bonariensis. Older local Texas floras place var. triradiata under verticillata; leave explicit scientific uncertainty and no silent renames.
taxon.state_native_source: Kew accepts Texas native state range; BONAP Hays and target-west counties not vetted

publish_policy: Only rights-filtered public GitHub Pages, no Cloudflare, no automation change, and success only after actual deployment result.
